name: Differentiable Voxelization from Radiative Gaussians
definition: A differentiable voxelizer V to efficiently query a density volume $V \in R^{X \times Y \times Z}$ from radiative Gaussians, used for 3D regularization.
summary: Differentiable Voxelization from Radiative Gaussians is a method that efficiently maps continuous Gaussian splats to a discrete 3D density grid using spatial tiling and CUDA backpropagation, unlike mesh-based voxelizers.
